layout.body:
AI-Generated Art on Campus
Visitors to the Petrunich Gallery can now view an exhibit of AI-generated paintings that blur the line between human creativity and machine learning. One standout work, Dream Algorithm, depicts a city floating in a sea of binary code, while another, Echoes of Light, uses layered brushstrokes created by artificial neural networks to mimic sunrise over glass towers.
The exhibit, which was funded by an arts innovation grant, allows visitors to interact with a program that generates custom artwork in real time, allowing them to choose themes and color palettes. This feature has become the centerpiece of the show, enchanting everyone from art majors to computer science instructors.
“We’re exploring the intersection of creativity and technology,” said curator Dana Fields. “It challenges what art means.”
“I made a painting with code—it felt empowering,” said senior art major Sofia Ramirez. “It’s a new frontier.”

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the article?

options.A: An art exhibit highlighting technology-driven creativity
options.B: A debate over mixing art and technology
options.C: How students are learning traditional painting
options.D: A plan to replace the art gallery with a data center

questions.analysis: What is the main topic of the article? 原文依据： Visitors to the Petrunich Gallery can now view an exhibit of AI-generated paintings that blur the line between human creativity and machine learning. 翻译： 彼得鲁尼奇画廊的访客现在可以参观一场人工智能生成画作的展览，这些画作模糊了人类创造力和机器学习之间的界限。 选项分析： (A) An art exhibit highlighting technology-driven creativity 一场凸显技术驱动型创造力的艺术展览 → 正确 (B) A debate over mixing art and technology 关于艺术与技术融合的争论 → 错误 (C) How students are learning traditional painting 学生们如何学习传统绘画 → 错误 (D) A plan to replace the art gallery with a data center 用数据中心取代艺术画廊的计划 → 错误

questions.stem: Which of the following is true of the exhibit?

options.A: Its dates have been extended because of public enthusiasm.
options.C: It merges artistic expression with digital innovation.

questions.analysis: Which of the following is true of the exhibit? 原文依据： The exhibit, which was funded by an arts innovation grant, allows visitors to interact with a program that generates custom artwork in real time, allowing them to choose themes and color palettes. 翻译： 这场展览由艺术创新基金资助，允许访客与一个实时生成定制艺术品的程序互动，让他们可以选择主题和调色板。 选项分析： (A) Its dates have been extended because of public enthusiasm. 由于公众的热情，其展期已延长 → 错误 (B) It prohibits visitor participation. 它禁止访客参与 → 错误 (C) It merges artistic expression with digital innovation. 它将艺术表达与数字创新相结合 → 正确 (D) It features computer-aided musical performances. 它以计算机辅助音乐表演为特色 → 错误

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the impact of the exhibit's interactive portion?

options.A: It asks visitors to consider the ethical implications of using AI to create art.
options.B: It has caused visitors to switch majors from art to computer science.
options.C: It has led to calls to replace traditional art with AI art.
options.D: It tries to help visitors feel comfortable using AI in their creative endeavors.
